papers.title: MetaFun: Meta-Learning with Iterative Functional Updates
papers.verified_operation: RKHS context residual functional descent generalized to learned local update/kernel-or-attention/decoder, trained on target loss.
papers.obstacle: Functional corrective updates and context-to-target transfer learning are prior.
papers.limits: Learned attention need not be PSD and learned u need not be a gradient; no universal native-gauge or correction guarantee.

papers.title: Meta-Learning with Warped Gradient Descent
papers.verified_operation: Shared warp layers held fixed during task adaptation, meta-trained on sampled one-step post-update losses; live and separately stopped derivative variants.
papers.obstacle: Shared/private adaptation geometry and post-step transfer credit are prior.
papers.limits: Nondegenerate Omega assumption and first-order nonlinear step equivalence do not prove exact finite invariance in redundant R/S coordinates; algorithm bodies/code not audited.

papers.title: ProMP: Proximal Meta-Policy Search
papers.verified_operation: Pre/post task policy adaptation with post-update clipped surrogate and pre-update policy KL penalty; Algorithm1 text read.
papers.obstacle: Statistical-distance control coupled to gradient adaptation/transfer is prior.
papers.limits: Soft/clipped controls are not a hard equal private output budget; discounted MDP theory does not transfer to supervised correlated graph episodes. Printed Eq107 normalization caveat retained.

one_falsifiable_extension: After controlling the actual output movement and current competence, private response allocation predicts/causes transferable common-error correction beyond ordinary same-geometry correction and matched live first-order utility.
rejection: Same complete-pool benefit from ordinary same-geometry training; gauge-created rankings; no response/transfer association; or S/oracle-only benefit with pool/competence failure.
